bio_en: Avetis Maghakian, known as Avo, came from Huseynik near Kharpert and settled in Constantinople as a youth. When the ARF first set foot in the capital, Yegiptatsi (Artashes Devian) drew him into the work, and he became one of its key organisers up to 1897, moving the bombs being prepared for the party. When the Central Committee decided on the Ottoman Bank action in August 1896, the defence of the Armenian quarter of Scutari was entrusted to him with 60 bombs and 55 revolvers; Scutari was spared the massacres that struck Hasköy, Kasımpaşa and Galata. Refusing to flee the city during the searches that followed, he went on recovering hidden weapons; he died in 1903.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Years 1858-1903 from the title.
